pump_restart_h.label: Pump restart after a power trip (h)
pump_restart_h.source: BWSSB officials (Deccan Herald): a ~20-minute outage can need nearly an hour to restart pumps

reservoir_refill_h.label: City reservoir refill after inflow returns (h)
reservoir_refill_h.source: BWSSB officials (Deccan Herald): about three more hours to refill ground-level reservoirs

reservoir_storage_h.label: Hours a city reservoir keeps supplying without inflow
reservoir_storage_h.source: Calibrated: with 1 h, a 20-minute trip gives ~4.3 h of disruption, matching BWSSB's description

reservoir_power_backup_h.label: Backup power at city distribution pumps (h)
reservoir_power_backup_h.source: Assumed none; Deccan Herald reports in-city distribution, not Cauvery pumping, is hit during load shedding

hospital_diesel_h.label: Hospital diesel backup (h)
hospital_diesel_h.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with the number from the hospital call

hospital_water_h.label: Hospital water storage (h)
hospital_water_h.source: PLACEHOLDER - replace with the number from the hospital call

hospital_dual_feed_min_beds.label: Hospitals with at least this many beds get two substations
hospital_dual_feed_min_beds.source: Assumption: larger hospitals usually have redundant feeds

tk_halli_flood_repair_h.label: TK Halli flood repair time (h)
tk_halli_flood_repair_h.source: Deccan Herald: BWSSB restored the flooded TK Halli pumping station in 36 hours (Sept 2022)

default_repair_h.label: Repair time for other failed facilities (h)

storage_h.label: Hours of extra water storage added at a hospital

cauvery_stages.label: Parallel Cauvery supply stages modelled
cauvery_stages.source: BWSSB's Cauvery scheme runs in stages I-V (Deccan Herald; Stage V per the April 2026 command-centre report). Which stage feeds which reservoir is inferred.

tk_halli_2022.label: Replay: TK Halli flood, Sept 2022
tk_halli_2022.note: Stage III and IV units at TK Halli submerged (as reported); restored in 36 h.

tk_halli_trip.label: 20-minute power trip at TK Halli
tk_halli_trip.note: BWSSB says a short trip costs ~1 h pump restart + ~3 h reservoir refill.

tk_halli_feeder.label: Power line to TK Halli damaged (like Oct 2024)
tk_halli_feeder.note: Rain and lightning damaged transformers feeding TK Halli and Harohalli in Oct 2024.

orr_flood.label: Flood on the Outer Ring Road (illustrative zone)
orr_flood.note: Illustrative zone around Bellandur-Marathahalli, not the mapped 2022 extent.

meta.attribution: Map data (c) OpenStreetMap contributors. Dependencies between facilities are inferred.
